//: Agents the glasses can talk to. Copy to agents.json to activate.
The built-in 'glass' agent (Claude with eyes + web search) is always registered and
does not appear here. Everything listed below is an ADDITIONAL agent reached by its
own wake phrase. The iOS app fetches GET /agents at launch and arms a trigger phrase
for each one, so adding an assistant is an edit here plus a backend restart. No app
type 'gateway' speaks to any HTTP endpoint that accepts a JSON POST and answers with
newline-delimited JSON events: {type:'text',text:...} lines and a final
{type:'done',text:...}. Field names are configurable for services that differ.
The agent owns its own memory. It receives a stable threadId per conversation and
decides what that means, so Glassbridge sends no history to gateway agents.
